pretrain.loss: FP64 observed nontied utility-difference BCE: per-query pair mean then batch mean
pretrain.sampling: A nested new-source 10k/task, replacement matching B natural actual sizes; B new90k/task
pretrain.forward: all legal candidates; observation masks are loss-only; one forward per update
pretrain.transfer: final full selector except score_head reset to shared scratch values; fresh optimizer/scaler

initialization: identical fresh seed2 R45A full selector; no historical weights
shared_controller: A determines LR trace and horizon; B follows exactly

label_sources.finetune: untouched original full18/fullpool legacy TRAIN and validation

geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k
